text: A messy handwritten shopping list? Snap a photo of it.
Ask an AI app: turn this into a checklist grouped by supermarket aisle.
Add: skip crossed-out items, and flag anything you can't read.
Here, bread was crossed out, so it is gone. And is that six eggs or eight? It gets flagged.
Before you shop, check the list against your photo, and fix anything it got wrong.
